title: Fesse
summary: FESSE, noun fess. [Latin fascia, a band.] In heraldry, a bank or girdle, possessing the third part of the escutcheon; one of the nine honorable ordinaries.

inlines.v: FESSE, noun fess. [Latin fascia, a band.] In heraldry, a bank or girdle, possessing the third part of the escutcheon; one of the nine honorable ordinaries.
